message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV directly and applies LabelEncoder without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The data is loaded from a local file path ('mushrooms.csv') with no checksum verification, and there is no remote source fetch at all, so no integrity or authentication controls are present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only applies LabelEncoder to transform labels without any validation of label distributions, comparison against expected label sets, or label-noise detection.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code reads the CSV and encodes columns directly with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded; models are instantiated and trained from scratch at runtime with no hash checks, signatures, or pinned revisions.
No detected label distribution validation: The code directly splits and trains on the data without any class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training flow.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) are imported or used; models are trained with standard sklearn fitting.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads a fixed CSV file and applies LabelEncoder without any validation of input shape, feature ranges, or rejection of malformed inputs before model inference.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and scores are written directly to the UI without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on the outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical ML classifier (SVM, Logistic Regression, Random Forest), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
